issues.on_page: Bond proceeds 1,298,620 printed among RECEIPTS on the p8 budget schedule
issues.issue: This is inconsistent within the same schedule. Bond proceeds is entered as other financing with no category, but 'Grants and donations' 180,938 (detail[13]), which sits in the same RECEIPTS block, is entered as revenue. At the top level both are entered as other financing, as p4 prints them. One treatment should apply to both p8 lines.
